HEDGEHOG HILLS - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

A little hedgehog rolls home over endless woodland hills, with winter on its heels.
Hold to curl up and gain speed DOWNHILL. Release before the climb to preserve
momentum and launch. A smooth downhill landing gives a speed and score bonus.
Gather apples; a rough landing spills some of them. Keep ahead of the frost!

Run HedgehogHills.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.

Keyboard: X or Z (also C, V, Up) = hold to roll; RELEASE to uncurl.
Gamepad: hold any face button (A, B, X, Y) to roll.
A / X starts from the title. Enter starts and pauses.
Backspace / Esc / Right Shift: pause and resume.
After game over, A / X returns to the title; press again to begin a new run.

Up to four players: players 2-4 press A on their controllers on the title to join,
B to leave. Player 1 starts. Each player has their own camera and frost indicator:
two players use top/bottom views; three or four use separate panels.
Falling behind another player does not eliminate you. Stay ahead of the frost!
The second keyboard uses H (A) / G (B), with T = Start and R = Select.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Optional: HedgehogHills.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
Best scores are saved in hedgehoghills.srm next to the executable.
Medals: 100 bronze, 250 silver, 500 gold, 1000 pearl.
